subtitle: Cross-reading for 21/Sep/2026: Polymarket in the reading confirmed at 16:21 BRT, with the winner contract held at the reading confirmed at 00:06 BRT the same day, plus the two national polls released that day, BTG/Nexus (registration BR-00485/2026, fieldwork 18 to 20/Sep) and Palver (registration BR-00860/2026, fieldwork 15 to 18/Sep), and the press flow of 21/Sep.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 41.50% (USD 11.47M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT. This round publishes no new price for that contract. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 0.30pp, to 29.25% (USD 0.88M), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. POLL: 40% in the first round and 46% in the second in BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep, ahead in both; 41% and 43% in Palver the same day, behind in both.
fortes: Leads both rounds in BTG/Nexus released on 21/Sep, registration BR-00485/2026, 2,006 voters by phone between 18 and 20/Sep and a 2.0pp margin: 40% to 37% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 46% to 45% in the second, both distances within two margins.

It is the most recent fieldwork of the day's two national polls: BTG/Nexus closed on 20/Sep and Palver on 18/Sep, and in those three days of difference lies the only thing separating the two firms' windows.
His contract in the winner book has USD 11.47M cumulative, the largest between the two names disputing the price, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT.
fracos: Loses both rounds in Palver released the same 21/Sep, registration BR-00860/2026, 5,000 voters online between 15 and 18/Sep and a 2.8pp margin: 41% to 42% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 43% to 47% in the second. The firm declares a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) in both.
In the winner contract he stands at 41.50% against 59.05% for Flávio Bolsonaro, a gap of 17.55pp, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT.
In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he gives up 0.30pp, to 29.25%, against 68.50% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the same book.
candidates.analise: The winner contract receives no new price this round: Lula stays at the 41.50% (USD 11.47M cumulative volume) of the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with the 17.55pp gap to Flávio Bolsonaro. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he gives up 0.30pp, to 29.25% (USD 0.88M), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. In the polls the day is one of disagreement between two firms that measured almost the same days: BTG/Nexus puts him ahead in both rounds and Palver puts him behind in both, and both declare a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). AFOS does not say which of the two better describes the electorate. It says they diverge in sign, not only in magnitude, and that both were released on the same 21/Sep.

candidates.name: Flávio Bolsonaro
candidates.header: PRICE: 59.05% (USD 11.18M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT. This round publishes no new price for that contract. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 2.00pp, to 68.50% (USD 1.05M), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. POLL: 42% in the first round and 47% in the second in Palver of 21/Sep, ahead in both; 37% and 45% in BTG/Nexus the same day, behind in both.
fortes: 59.05% in the winner contract, with USD 11.18M cumulative, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, against 41.50% for Lula in the same book.

Leads both rounds in Palver released on 21/Sep, registration BR-00860/2026, 5,000 voters online between 15 and 18/Sep and a 2.8pp margin: 42% to 41% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 47% to 43% in the second.
He is the name the market prices first in the winner book and in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place book at the same time, with 68.50% in the latter.
fracos: Loses both rounds in BTG/Nexus released the same 21/Sep, registration BR-00485/2026, 2,006 voters by phone between 18 and 20/Sep and a 2.0pp margin: 37% to 40% in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and 45% to 46% in the second.

In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he falls 2.00pp, to 68.50%, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, and that was the day's largest drop outside the third-place book.

The volume of his contract in the winner book, USD 11.18M cumulative, is smaller than Lula's, at USD 11.47M, than Renan Santos's, at USD 13.89M, and than Tarcísio de Freitas's, at USD 14.08M, which is the largest in the book. High volume measures cumulative interest since opening, not probability now.
candidates.analise: The winner contract receives no new price this round: Flávio Bolsonaro stays at the 59.05% (USD 11.18M cumulative volume) of the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) second-place contract he gives up 2.00pp, to 68.50% (USD 1.05M), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. In the day's two national polls he appears ahead in Palver in both rounds and behind in BTG/Nexus in both, always within the declared margins, and both firms record a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico). On 21/Sep the Ministry of Justice formalized the dismissal of Eduardo Bolsonaro from his post as a [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) clerk for job abandonment. The proceeding is not from that day: the Federal Police itself concluded the inquiry and recommended the removal in July, and what changed on 21/Sep was the minister's formalization. The panel does not claim the act moved any price.

candidates.name: Augusto Cury
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.05% in the winner contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, and 40.25% (USD 0.25M cumulative volume) in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, up 7.70pp in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. POLL: 6% in the first round in BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep, in third place.
fortes: Rises 7.70pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 40.25% (USD 0.25M cumulative volume), the largest rise of any contract on the panel this round, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT.
The distance to Renan Santos in that book shrank from 19.95pp to 5.25pp in a little over sixteen hours, and the price began moving in the direction the polls have been measuring.
He is third in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep, with 6%, ahead of Ronaldo Caiado and Renan Santos in that same wave.
fracos: In the winner contract he stays at 0.05%, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with USD 4.98M cumulative.
He remains second in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, behind Renan Santos, contrary to what the polls measure in the third way.
Today's move is not a series extreme: in the backup he has been at 60.30% in this same contract, on 04/Sep. What the round measures is the size of the shift, not a record level.
candidates.analise: Augusto Cury rose 7.70pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, from 32.55% to 40.25% (USD 0.25M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT. It was the largest rise among the contracts that received a new price this round. On the other side of the same book, Renan Santos fell 7.00pp, and the distance between the two shrank from 19.95pp to 5.25pp. The direction of the move is the polls' direction: the day's BTG/Nexus puts him third in the first round, with 6%, and the third-way order the firms measure is no longer so far from the order the book pays. The panel records the convergence and asserts no cause.

candidates.name: Renan Santos
candidates.header: PRICE: 0.75% (USD 13.89M cumulative volume) in the winner contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, and 45.50% (USD 0.36M cumulative volume) in the third-place contract, down 7.00pp in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. POLL: he does not appear among the names released in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep.
fortes: He remains ahead in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, with 45.50%, and it is the contract with the largest cumulative volume in that book, USD 0.36M.
In the winner book his contract has USD 13.89M cumulative, the second largest in the entire presidential book, behind only Tarcísio de Freitas's, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT.
He filed a petition at the Superior Electoral Court against the Bolsa Família increase on Sep 17, and the rapporteur drawn was André Mendonça.
fracos: Falls 7.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, from 52.50% to 45.50%, the largest drop of any contract on the panel this round, against the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT.
His lead over Augusto Cury in that book shrank from 19.95pp to 5.25pp in a little over sixteen hours.
In the winner contract he stands at 0.75%, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with USD 13.89M cumulative: high volume and a price at the book's floor.
candidates.analise: Renan Santos fell 7.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, from 52.50% to 45.50% (USD 0.36M cumulative volume), in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT, and remains ahead, with his lead over Augusto Cury shrinking from 19.95pp to 5.25pp in that same window. In the winner contract he stands at 0.75%, with USD 13.89M cumulative, the second largest volume in the presidential book, which measures cumulative interest since opening and not probability now. The divergence between the book and the polls on the order of the third way still exists, and today it narrowed: the market still puts him first in that contract, and the day's BTG/Nexus releases Augusto Cury at 6% in the first round without listing him among the published names.

candidates.name: Caiado / Haddad / Zema
candidates.header: PRICE: Ronaldo Caiado 0.05% in the winner contract and 15.50% in the third-place contract, up 4.00pp; Romeu Zema 0.15% and 0.50% in the third-place contract, down 0.55pp; Fernando Haddad 0.05%. The winner contracts come from the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT and the third-place ones from the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. POLL: none of the three appears among the names released in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) of BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep.
candidates.subtitle: The three names outside the leading pack. The winner contract comes from the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT and receives no new price this round; the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract comes from the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. The polls are the two national ones released on 21/Sep, which do not publish their first-round numbers.

caiado.label: CAIADO (PSD), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with no new price this round and below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE contract he rises 4.00pp, to 15.50%, in a book of USD 0.14M cumulative, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT.
caiado.fortes: Rises 4.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 15.50%, the third largest rise of the round, and holds third position in that book. He is the only one of the three names in this block to gain price this round.
caiado.fracos: In the winner contract he stays at 0.05%, with no new price this round, with USD 7.64M cumulative. Neither BTG/Nexus nor Palver of 21/Sep publishes his [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) number, and neither tests him in a second-round pairing.

haddad.label: HADDAD (PT), 0.05% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with no new price this round, at the book's floor. He is not a presidential candidate: he is running for the government of São Paulo, and the two national polls of 21/Sep do not test him in a [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) presidential scenario.
haddad.fortes: His contract receives no new price this round, so there is no move to explain, and the top of his series in the winner contract is 7.60%, on 26/May, measured in the database backup.
haddad.fracos: He is not measured in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by the two national polls of 21/Sep, so the comparison between price and poll does not exist for him this round. His winner contract accumulates USD 7.54M, a larger volume than Augusto Cury's, who is tested in the polls and has USD 4.98M.

zema.label: ZEMA (Novo), 0.15% in the WINNER contract, reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with no new price this round and still below the 0.5% floor of the double reading. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD-PLACE contract he falls 0.55pp, to 0.50%, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT.
zema.fortes: He remains at 0.15% in the winner contract, above the floor of his series, 0.10% on 17/Sep, even though the value stays below the 0.5% cut the panel uses to treat a thin price as noise.
zema.fracos: Falls 0.55pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 0.50%, and neither of the two national polls of 21/Sep publishes his first-round number nor tests him in a second-round pairing. The top of his series in the winner contract is 12.00%, on 13/May.

candidates.analise: In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place book, the only one that moved this round, Ronaldo Caiado rises 4.00pp, to 15.50% (USD 0.14M cumulative volume), and Romeu Zema falls 0.55pp, to 0.50%, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT. In the winner contracts the three stay at the values of the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, which this round does not update: Ronaldo Caiado at 0.05%, Romeu Zema at 0.15% and Fernando Haddad at 0.05%. None of the three appears among the names BTG/Nexus released in the first round of 21/Sep, so this round they have a price and no new poll number.
fortes: Ronaldo Caiado rises 4.00pp in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract, to 15.50% (USD 0.14M cumulative volume), the third largest rise of the round, and holds third position in that book, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep, 16:21 BRT.
His move tracks that of the entire third-place book, the only one to move this round, with the three leading names shifting at the same time.
fracos: Ronaldo Caiado stays at 0.05% in the winner contract, in the reading confirmed on 21/Sep at 00:06 BRT, with USD 7.64M cumulative.
Romeu Zema falls 0.55pp in the third-place contract, to 0.50%, and stays at 0.15% in the winner contract, with no new price this round.
Fernando Haddad stays at 0.05% in the winner contract, with no new price this round, and is not tested in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) by BTG/Nexus or by Palver of 21/Sep.

In Palver the same day (fieldwork 15 to 18/Sep, online, 5,000 interviews, 2.8pp margin) he has 41% in the first round and loses the second 43% to 47%.

cruzamento: The round's finding is not in the winner contract, which receives no new price, it is in the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) third-place contract. Augusto Cury rises 7.70pp and Renan Santos falls 7.00pp in a little over sixteen hours, and the distance between the two shrinks from 19.95pp to 5.25pp. The polls had been saying something else about that pack: in Datafolha of 17/Sep and Futura/100% Cidades the same day, Cury appears third in the first round, ahead of Renan Santos, and BTG/Nexus of 21/Sep repeats the picture with Cury at 6%. The contract moved in the direction the declared ballots had been measuring, without reaching it. ⚠️ None of these prices is an extreme: in the backup, Cury has been at 60.30% in this same contract on 04/Sep. What is measured here is the speed of the repricing, not a record. And in the day's two national polls the top of the race still has no consensus: BTG/Nexus puts Lula ahead in both rounds and Palver puts Flávio Bolsonaro ahead in both, with both firms declaring a [statistical tie](/en/glossary#empate-tecnico) and with almost overlapping fieldwork.
